analyst_view.overall: Fourth-placed Twente (24 pts, best defence in the league) host bottom side Willem II, who have 3 points from 12 games, a league-high 40 goals conceded and a league-low 11 scored. Willem II miss captain Justin Hoogma (knee) and Amine Lachkar (groin), both counted, and Goal also lists Thijs Muller injured and winger Jaden Slory suspended, which the numbers don't list; keeper Thomas Didillon is doubtful, with Delanghe expected to start. Twente miss keeper Lars Unnerstall, Max Bruns, Stav Lemkin and Filip Thorvaldsen (sixth game out); the numbers count only Bruns, but the others have been out for weeks so recent form reflects it. Coach John van den Brom says the focus is on Sunday before a run of away games including Freiburg in the Conference League, so little rotation is expected. Referee Serdar Gozubuyuk's high card rate is already counted.

goals.text: The numbers say 4.0 goals, already lifted for Twente's 21 goals in their last six and Willem II's 21 conceded. Thorvaldsen is out again, but Twente scored freely without him, and Willem II's losses (Slory banned, Didillon doubtful) cut both ways, so I stay at 4.0.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.8 corners, already up for Twente's 46 corners in six (+6%) and down for Willem II's low output. Willem II expect to be pushed back, which is exactly the one-sided pattern those figures describe, so I stay at 10.8.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.1 cards, with Serdar Gozubuyuk's 3.9 a game (+37%) and Willem II's 12 cards in six already counted. A side defending deep for long spells picks up cards, but that is priced in, and Slory's ban removes one of Willem II's players rather than adding needle, so I stay at 4.1.

shots.text: The numbers say 35.6 shots, already lifted strongly for Twente's 145 shots in six (+25%) and cut for Willem II's low output. Without Slory Willem II have even less going forward, but that is a few shots at most and Twente's dominance is already priced in, so I stay at 35.6.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 11.2 shots on target, already up for Twente's accuracy (+14%) and down for Willem II's (-9%). Twente's absences are ones they have played without for weeks and Weghorst should lead the line, so I stay at 11.2.
